evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield video prompt for the cheeseburger, roughly 15-25 lines, opening with a 2-second hook on the slow-motion cheese pull/stretch and including camera, lighting, and timeline sections tuned for appetite appeal.

evals.prompt: Make a satisfying ASMR-style clip of pouring thick caramel sauce over a stack of pancakes, with the syrup slowly cascading down the sides. I want every drip to look irresistible.
evals.expected_output: A Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield prompt of about 15-25 lines opening on a 2-second slow-motion sauce-pour hook, with macro camera moves, backlit/golden lighting to make the caramel shine, and a timeline of the cascade and pooling for ASMR satisfaction.
expectations: The prompt opens on a 2-second hook featuring the slow-motion caramel/syrup pour cascading over the pancakes.
It specifies camera work (macro / close-up / glide) and lighting (backlit or golden-hour) chosen to make the sauce glisten.
It includes a timeline or shot sequence covering the pour, cascade, and pooling moments.
It emphasizes ASMR-satisfying, appetite-triggering texture detail (drips, sheen, viscosity).

evals.prompt: Our craft brewery is launching a new IPA and I need a hero video that shows beer being poured into a chilled glass with bubbles rising and a foamy head forming. Help me write the prompt.
evals.expected_output: A Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield beverage prompt of roughly 15-25 lines that opens on a 2-second hook of rising carbonation bubbles and foam head, with backlit lighting for luminosity, defined camera moves, and a timeline of the pour and foam settle.
expectations: The prompt targets Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield and is framed as a beverage/drink hero video.
The 2-second hook is built on bubbles rising and the foam head forming in the chilled glass.
It calls for backlit or luminous lighting plus specific camera framing and a timeline of the pour and settle.
